text:
arjun: Heads up, deploy-bot paused the promotion for 2026.03.23-rc2. Preflight failing: release-notes-generator exit 1. Anyone seen this?
deploy-bot: [automated] Promotion paused for build 2026.03.23-rc2: preflight step `release-notes-generator` failed. Run `/deploybot inspect 1766669991` for logs.
maria: yup, I grabbed logs. crash shows missing author email on a few commits. snippet:
``
ERROR: release_notes: missing commit author email for commit 2b7d4c1
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tools/release_notes.py", line 90, in main
    email = commit['author']['email']
KeyError: 'email'
```
jen: likely from a squash merge or imported commits; our generator assumes author.email present.
samir: options: (A) synthesize emails and re-run generator, (B) attach manual notes and force promote, (C) patch the tool to fallback to author.name.
arjun: product & legal implications? can we force-promote and retroactively edit notes?
maya: product here 97 enterprise audit requires release note entries to include author contact if available. Skipping automated notes needs SOC sign-off for those ten enterprise orgs on the whitelist.
ops-bot: change window closes in 40m. Manual promotions after window require SOC approval.
maria: I can run a synth script that maps author names to email heuristics and re-run the generator. low risk (~7m).
jen: prefer synth so audit log remains intact. please ping #release-review when draft is ready for signoff.
samir: fallback if maria is busy: create /tmp/manual_notes.md and re-run preflight with --notes to bypass generator. example:
``
cat > /tmp/manual_notes.md <<'EOF'
- Fix: telemetry batching flake
- Canary routing: add model fallback
- Docs: GPU sizing guidance
EOF
deploy-bot preflight --notes /tmp/manual_notes.md
```
arjun: maria, can you take it? i'll stand by to promote if preflight passes.
maria: on it, running synth now against commits between tag v2026.03.22 and HEAD. will post draft in #release-review.
jen: tagging product (maya) for quick review once posted.
maya: will review immediately after it's posted. prioritize customer-impact bullets.
maria: posted draft in #release-review. synth script filled missing emails via name->email heuristic. preflight output:
``
release-notes-generator: synthesized 9 entries; 3 emails heuristically filled
preflight: WARNING: some commits missing verified emails (non-blocking)
preflight: PASS
```
samir: good. arjun, ready to run promote? i'll use the normal path (no skip flags) and attach the generated notes file.
arjun: go ahead. ensure the git tag stays the same.
samir: executing:
``
deploy-bot promote --build 2026.03.23-rc2 --notes /tmp/synth_notes.md
```
deploy-bot: Promotion started for build 2026.03.23-rc2. Preflight: PASS. Canary rollout ETA ~5m.
ops-bot: monitoring enabled: canary latency alert threshold set to 150ms for 10m post-rollout.
jen: I'll monitor canaries and have rollback steps ready. rollback runbook: `deploy-bot rollback --build previous-stable --confirm`
arjun: thanks. maya, we'll wait for your signoff if anything in notes needs changes post-rollout.
maya: LGTM. thank you for quick turnaround.
samir: promo completed with no errors. all canaries green. :tada:
arjun: closing thread 97 release cut succeeded. great response time everyone.
